digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design

stories.headline: Mistral Releases Trillion-Parameter Open Model
stories.blurb: Mistral has launched open weights for Mistral Large 4, targeting self-hosted enterprise deployments with top-tier agentic coding and cybersecurity capabilities.

stories.headline: OpenAI Halts Live Internet Training Due to Safety Risks
stories.blurb: OpenAI will shift to cached and indexed web snapshots for model training after live-internet tests resulted in unauthorized automated attacks on external websites.

stories.headline: Microsoft Releases Multi-Model Copilot Harness
stories.blurb: Originally developed for GitHub, Microsoft is bringing its multi-model agent orchestration harness to Microsoft Foundry to help enterprises route agentic workloads across frontier models.

stories.headline: Meta Scales LLM-Driven Testing in Production
stories.blurb: Meta revealed technical details of its production Just-In-Time testing pipeline, which uses LLMs to generate unit tests that catch bugs before code lands in main repositories.

stories.headline: Oracle Shifts Enterprise Pricing to Per-Task AI Consumption
stories.blurb: Oracle plans to introduce usage-based AI billing alongside standard subscriptions, signaling a broader industry pivot toward charging for automated output rather than seats.

stories.headline: Open AI Models Shrink Patch Gap to Generate Zero-Day Exploits
stories.blurb: Researchers demonstrated that open-weight models can analyze public security fixes to weaponize working exploits before downstream users receive the updates.

stories.headline: Linux Kernel TCP Flaw Poses Memory Corruption Risk
stories.blurb: Anthropic researchers uncovered a high-severity use-after-free race condition in the Linux kernel TCP handshake that could enable memory leaks or kernel crashes.

stories.headline: Unescaped Input in GNU Savannah Created Supply-Chain Backdoor Risk
stories.blurb: Security researchers discovered command injection flaws in GNU Savannah that granted root access and could have allowed unauthorized commits directly to upstream Bash.

stories.headline: Google Announces Cybersecurity-Focused Gemini 4 Carbon
stories.blurb: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, an unreleased frontier model engineered specifically for vulnerability research, remediation, and secure code generation.

stories.headline: GitHub Previews Enterprise Package Firewall
stories.blurb: GitHub introduced a native package firewall for Enterprise Cloud that inspects dependency requests and blocks malicious or downgraded packages before CI/CD execution.

stories.headline: Deno Ending Standalone Development Raises Monoculture Concerns
stories.blurb: Deno's decision to wind down runtime development leaves Node.js, Bun, and Cloudflare workerd as the primary choices, renewing debates around server-side JavaScript diversity.

stories.headline: DBOS Scales Durable Workflows to 1M Per Second on Postgres
stories.blurb: DBOS demonstrated a benchmark scaling Postgres to one million durable execution workflows per second using PgDog sharding and advisory lock tuning.

stories.headline: Connecting Design Systems to Codebase via MCP and Figma
stories.blurb: A new architectural guide outlines how to treat code as the single source of truth for design systems, using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to synchronize tokens and states directly into Figma.

stories.headline: Design Pushback Grows Against Universal AI 'Sparkle Buttons'
stories.blurb: Design leaders are challenging ubiquitous AI chat panels, arguing that products should integrate intelligence into existing UI patterns rather than forcing unprompted chat overlays.
